mintAuthority.summary: At Celo block 78972424, CADm issuance uses the V2 Broker and legacy BiPoolManager. The two-day Mento Timelock owns the token and Broker and can raise trading limits. The BiPoolManager pricing/configuration owner is a separate 4-of-6 migration Safe. Validators is token-authorized, but its current mint function targets registry USDm and only registry EpochManager can invoke it. Celo Governance owns both the Validators proxy and Registry: upgrades or registry reassignment can enable a latent CADm mint path. No Mento Timelock protection is attributed to Celo Governance.

upgradeability.controlRef: Mento Timelock - CADm token and Broker administrator

controls.label: Mento Broker - operational CADm swap minter
controls.evidence: At finalized Celo block 72780426, broker() on CADm returned this Broker. Broker swaps call transferIn to burn the incoming Mento stable and transferOut to mint the outgoing stable only through registered exchanges subject to exchange and trading-limit checks.

controls.label: Mento Timelock - CADm token and Broker administrator
controls.evidence: At finalized Celo block 72780426, CADm owner(), token proxy owner, and Broker proxy owner returned this Timelock; getMinDelay() returned 172800 seconds. StableTokenV2 ownership can change broker, validators, and exchange authorization slots, while the proxy role can replace token and Broker mint-critical logic.

controls.label: Celo ValidatorsProxy - authorized CADm minter slot
controls.evidence: At finalized Celo block 72780426, validators() on CADm returned this proxy and StableTokenV2 admitted it through onlyMinter. The current Validators implementation can mint only Registry USDm to EpochManager and has no generic or CADm-targeting call, so the slot is authorized but cannot currently issue CADm.

controls.label: Celo GovernanceProxy - Validators proxy upgrade owner
controls.evidence: At Celo block 78972424, ValidatorsProxy _getOwner(), Registry owner(), and Registry proxy _getOwner() resolve to Celo Governance. Validators currently mints only Registry USDm to registered EpochManager. Registry setAddressFor is onlyOwner and can replace StableToken and EpochManager; the Validators implementation is separately replaceable by this owner. These mutable target/caller and upgrade paths can authorize CADm issuance without attributing the Mento Timelock delay to Celo Governance.

controls.label: Mento migration Safe - legacy FX pool configuration
controls.evidence: At Celo block 78972424, BiPoolManager owner() is this 4-of-6 Safe; getModulesPaginated returns no enabled modules and the guard slot is zero. Verified BiPoolManager source permits owner-only pricing-module, oracle, spread and exchange configuration that determines Broker issuance quotes. It cannot call Broker configureTradingLimit, which is restricted to the separate Broker owner. BiPoolManager proxy administration remains the Mento Timelock.

review.evidence: At finalized Celo block 72780426, CADm broker(), owner(), validators(), and exchange() returned the Mento Broker, two-day Mento Timelock, Celo ValidatorsProxy, and zero address respectively. Proxy introspection resolved the current token and Broker implementations and administrators. The Broker is the live swap mint/burn path; the current Validators implementation can only mint Registry USDm, while its Celo-Governance-owned proxy remains a latent upgrade-controlled authorization surface. Economic-posture fields reviewed 2026-08-15: the Mento Timelock and broad Celo governance bound the live and latent raise paths, the CADm-scoped live adapter covers the full shared reserve continuously, and no named prudential regulator or independent attestor applies.
